messages.author: 4b58dae6963fae5e
messages.subject: Add blank observation row?
parts:
Hi all,

Seems like a silly question. I'm using the standalone version of Distance (not R) and noted an error in one of my observations. I have "0s" for a Perp distance and a Cluster size that should be blank (We saw no animals on that transect. We did not see any animals right on the transect). Rather than re-enter all of the date, I've tried to unlock the data sheet and tried to delete the 0s, but every time I do so a 0 is auto-filled. There's blank boxes in the observations above on different transects... 

Any thoughts?

Thanks,

Brandon

messages.author: 7482eee8d2863d12
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Add blank observation row?
parts:
Hi Brandon,

Click anywhere on that row in the Observation layer, and then choose the
menu item Data | Delete Record. You'll also see the same button on the
Project Browser Data tab - it's the button with two horizontal blue
lines and a red X between them (you can hover your mouse over the
buttons to find out what they do - this one says "Delete Current Record").

Cheers, Len
